item.title: African Financial Research
item.content:encoded:
This call for papers invites research proposals focused on African financial systems, markets, and institutions. Research examining financial dynamics, institutional development, and monetary aspects of African economies is welcomed.

Potential topics

  • African financial markets
  • Financial institutions in Africa
  • Money markets in Africa
  • International financial connections to Africa

Timeline

  • May 30, 2027: Submission deadline
